documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Issuance Of Corrigendum To The Notice Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting No. 01/2026 27 To Be Held On October 29, 2026.

Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Friday, October 23, 2026 - Substitution Of Proposed Allottees And Issuance Of Corrigendum To The Notice Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting No. 01/2026 27 Of D. P. Abhushan Limited
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited reported strong financial performance for the first quarter of FY27, with revenue growing 58% year-on-year to Rs. 853.63 crores and PAT increasing by 77% to Rs. 64 crores. Management highlighted robust footfalls, a high conversion rate of 81%, and a same-store sales growth of 52% during the quarter.

guidance.claim: The company targets approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: Broadly, we are targeting around 10% volume growth going forward. Internally, our primary focus remains on volume growth, and we believe that achieving around 10% growth in volumes is a reasonable target.

guidance.claim: Management maintains its vision of reaching a total of 51 stores by FY30.
guidance.quote: So, by this way we will achieve this 51 which is our vision also.

guidance.claim: D.P. Abhushan plans to expand its presence across Tier 2 & 3 cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, and Maharashtra in the upcoming 5 years.
guidance.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

guidance.claim: Showroom development activities at Jabalpur and Dahod are progressing, and the stores are expected to become operational shortly.
guidance.quote: Fit-out and showroom development activities are progressing at both locations, and the stores are expected to become operational shortly.

guidance.claim: Management aims to grow top-line revenue at an annual rate of 25% to 30% by the end of 2030.
guidance.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of delivering revenue growth of around 20%+ in the current year.
guidance.quote: With these factors in place, we are quite confident of delivering 20%+ growth in the current year as well.

guidance.claim: The company targets revenue of INR 4,800 crores for FY27 and INR 5,500 crores for FY28.
guidance.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margin guidance for FY27 is set at around 6% to 6.5%.
guidance.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins between 8% and 8.5% by FY30.
guidance.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

guidance.claim: The company targets 3% to 5% of top-line revenue from online channels over the next three to five years.
guidance.quote: So, over the long term, in the next three to five years, we are targeting around 3% to 5% of our topline revenue to come from this segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer demand remained healthy across all operating markets during the quarter supported by festive occasions and summer weddings.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across all our operating markets during the quarter. People are buying jewellery not only for regular consumption but also as an investment.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer demand remained healthy across the company's markets during Q1 FY27, supported by consumption-led and investment-led purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across our markets during the quarter, supported by both consumption-led and investment-led purchases.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange contributed approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27 following government announcements and higher customer awareness.
demand_outlook.quote: Following recent government announcements and heightened customer awareness, participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further, with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Wedding jewellery dominates the company's product mix at ~60%, followed by festival and lightweight jewellery at ~25%.
demand_outlook.quote: From a product mix perspective, wedding jewellery continues to dominate at ~60%, followed by festival and lightweight jewellery at ~25%, and corporate and other gifting at ~15%, reflecting a well-diversified and demand-aligned portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Silver segment revenue grew by ~168% YoY to INR 183 crores in FY26, while diamond segment revenue fell ~5% YoY.
demand_outlook.quote: The silver segment emerged as a key growth area, increasing significantly from INR68 crores to INR183 crores, delivering a strong ~168% YoY growth on the other hand, the diamond segment saw a marginal decline of ~5% YoY, reflecting some moderation in premium discretionary spending.

demand_outlook.claim: In FY26, overall volume declined by around 20% due to high gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: In FY26, most of our growth was driven by value rather than volume. On the volume side, we actually saw a decline of around 20% overall.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange currently contributes around 35% to 40% of sales.
demand_outlook.quote: So, the old gold exchange is somewhere 35% to 40% as of now.

demand_outlook.claim: The online segment is expected to contribute incremental annual profits of INR 25 to INR 30 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of profitability, we expect this segment to contribute an incremental INR25 to INR30 crores in profit annually.

capex_expansion.claim: The company finalized locations for new showrooms in Jabalpur and Dahod.
capex_expansion.quote: Under this roadmap, we have successfully finalized the locations for new showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and operate under the COCO model.
capex_expansion.quote: The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and will mark our strategic entry into the Gujarat market. This showroom will operate under the Company-Owned Company-Operated model.

capex_expansion.claim: Locations for upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh and Dahod, Gujarat have been finalized with required agreements and approvals.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully finalized locations for its upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh and Dahod, Gujarat, with all key agreements, approvals, and necessary formalities completed.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its retail showroom count to 12 following store openings in Ratlam and Dhar.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new s in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to open three to four new COCO stores and one franchisee store this year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year, we have planned to open three to four new stores. Additionally, we have already finalized one franchisee and will be opening one franchise store as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company holds a long-term goal of reaching around 51 stores by 2030.
capex_expansion.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open a store in Jodhpur and target Jaipur in the next one to two years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are planning to open a store in Jodhpur, and Jaipur is definitely part of our future expansion roadmap. We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

capex_expansion.claim: Expansion into Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Chhattisgarh is being planned on a priority basis.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Gujarat, Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh is on the priority basis, we are planning to enter.

margins_costs.claim: Total revenue for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 853.63 crores, registering a 58% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: During Quarter 1 '27, our total revenue stood at INR853.63 crores as compared to INR541 crores in Quarter 1 FY26, registering a strong growth of 58% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: At operating level, EBITDA increased by 70% year-on-year to INR93.99 crores in Q1 '27 as compared to INR55 crores in Q1 '26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin expanded by 82 basis points year-on-year to 7.55% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin expanded to 7.55%, up 82 basis points year-on-year, reflecting strong profitability growth and sustained efficiency across the businesses.

margins_costs.claim: The company uses Gold Metal Loans and hedging mechanisms on commodity exchanges to mitigate gold price volatility.
margins_costs.quote: Continue to follow a disciplined approach towards gold procurement and inventory management, exchange gold, leveraging Gold Metal Loans (GMLs) and hedging mechanisms at commodity exchange platform to mitigate gold price volatility while supporting margin stability and working capital efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 EBITDA margins expanded by 234 basis points to 7.61%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR309.7 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 77% YoY, with EBITDA margins improving to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Geopolitical situations and gold price volatility affected margins in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: See Chetan, the gold prices was playing a very important role in the last quarter, which everybody has visualized, because of the geopolitical situation.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects to maintain steady gross margins of approximately 10% to 11%.
margins_costs.quote: As far as gross margins are concerned, we expect the business to maintain approximately 10% to 11%.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory gains reflected in the books accounted for approximately 28% to 30%.
margins_costs.quote: Approximately 28% to 30% of the inventory gains have been reflected in our books.

orders_capacity.claim: Same-store sales growth stood at 52% on an overall basis during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Our same-store sales growth stood at 52% on an overall basis.

orders_capacity.claim: The footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81% during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: In Q1 FY27, footfall at our stores was encouraging, and the footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81%, showing strong buying intent and effective in-store engagement.

orders_capacity.claim: Total retail store area reached ~53,650 sq. ft. during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total retail store area stood at ~53,650 sq. ft. supporting our growing scale of operations.

orders_capacity.claim: Store productivity delivered average revenue of ~INR 7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and ~INR 339 crores per store in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: On the productivity front, we delivered an average revenue of ~INR7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and ~INR339 crores per store for FY26, reflecting strong store-level performance and efficient utilization of retail space.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall store conversion rates remained stable at ~82%–83%.
orders_capacity.quote: Our store-level conversion remains strong, with key stores such as Ratlam and Ratlam II delivering higher-than-average conversion levels, while overall conversion has remained largely stable at ~82%–83%.

orders_capacity.claim: Year-on-year same-store sales growth stood at ~20%.
orders_capacity.quote: So yeah, the number of the same-store sales growth is ~20% is the SSG growth.

capital_allocation.claim: The company aims to improve capital efficiency by using exchange-led schemes and structured gold savings schemes to reduce dependence on fresh gold procurement.
capital_allocation.quote: Reducing dependence on fresh gold procurement through exchange-led scheme and Structured Gold Savings Accumulation Scheme, thereby improving capital efficiency and sustaining sales even at higher gold prices.

capital_allocation.claim: The company put its QIP plans on hold due to unfavourable market conditions.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we are planning to undertake a QIP; however, we have currently put it on hold as market conditions are not favourable. As a result, we have not proceeded with it yet.

capital_allocation.claim: Store expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 will be funded through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: As far as our expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 are concerned, they will be executed through internal accruals as well.

capital_allocation.claim: Over 90% to 95% of investments are in inventory, eliminating the need for long-term borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: If you look at our balance sheet, more than 90% to 95% of our investment is in inventory. So, our capital requirement is largely driven by inventory, and there is no immediate need for long-term funding.

capital_allocation.claim: Normalized inventory days are targeted to stay between 75 and 85 days in the long run.
capital_allocation.quote: It is going to remain between 75 to 85 days, not more than that far as our business model is concerned.

risks_headwinds.claim: The increase in gold import duty to 15% in May 2026 introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the recent government announcement and increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 has introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity, the long-term fundamentals of the sector remain intact

risks_headwinds.claim: The government raised the import duty on gold and silver from approximately 6% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Government raised the import duty on gold (and silver) from ~6% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: High and volatile gold prices during FY26 muted consumer volume growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: Throughout FY26, gold prices were on an upward trajectory and quite volatile, which impacted affordability and consumer buying patterns. As a result, while value growth remained strong, volume growth was relatively muted.

risks_headwinds.claim: Inventory days elevated to 100 days due to upfront stocking for the new Dhar showroom opened late in March.
risks_headwinds.quote: We inaugurated the showroom on the 29th of March, but the preparations required, including stocking a substantial amount of inventory, had already been done beforehand. That is the reason you would have observed that the inventory levels appear on the higher side; otherwise, they would have been normal.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets to increase the studded ratio up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis by March 2028.
management_commitments.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets approximately 10% volume growth for FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Broadly, we are targeting around 10% volume growth going forward. Internally, our primary focus remains on volume growth, and we believe that achieving around 10% growth in volumes is a reasonable target.

management_commitments.claim: Showroom fit-out and development activities are ongoing at Dahod and Jabalpur, with operations expected to begin shortly.
management_commitments.quote: Fit-out and showroom development activities are progressing at both locations, and the stores are expected to become operational shortly.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve an annual top-line growth rate of 25% to 30% by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets top-line revenues of INR 4,800 crores for FY27 and INR 5,500 crores for FY28.
management_commitments.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets EBITDA margins of 8% to 8.5% by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach around 51 stores in total by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to expand into Jaipur within the next one to two years.
management_commitments.quote: We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
